summary: RETEST of the 8 membership money fixes from iter100. I verified them independently with new probes instead of re-running test_membership_batch.py. All 8 fixes HOLD. (1) GST-at-create / UPI path: member gets ₹50, revenue is ₹50 (₹25 with an inviter), no second GST booking; the row shows 25/18/50. (2) Race safety: 8 concurrent triggers, plus a mix of 8 concurrent direct split calls, 4 concurrent triggers and 3 sequential re-triggers. Every case booked direct_signup, gst (+18), total_earned and every row exactly once; member ₹50 and inviter ₹25 exactly once. A unique sparse index exists on transactions.idempotency_key. The real UPI-manual approve endpoint, hit by 4 concurrent + 2 sequential admin POSTs, paid member 50, revenue +50 and direct_added net 0, with one row of each kind and one deposit. (3) The claim is released on a refused split: re-triggering after the ₹118 row lands pays 50/25. (4) Strict payment check: a ₹10 wallet_topup, a ₹10 registration_fee, a pending ₹118, a ₹118 row with no status and a ₹118 wallet_topup all book nothing and release the claim. A ₹118 registration_fee success, a ₹118 registration_fee_upi paid and a ₹117 completed row all book 50/50/18. (5) Config: an oversized bonus returns 400 and is not persisted (checked on both the admin and public GET). Price, switches and WhatsApp round-trip. Lowering cashback_pct to 40 allows a ₹55 bonus; raising it to 60 with that bonus returns 400. (6) total_earned rises by +25 with an inviter. (7) Real COD orders: the free testbuyer's line froze 0% and no cashback rows were written. As a member, the line froze the shop's 5% and settled exactly one ₹10 cashback_credit plus one cashback_funding across 3 delivery replays. (8) With valid bodies, /service/apply, /vendor/apply and /delivery-partner/apply all return 403 for a free account, and no application was created. Regression is green: owner_batch 13/13, iter96_reconciliation 7/7, iter98_final_batch + iter99_closing 20/20, iter100 money probe 26/26. Vendor in_sync is true with unledgered 0. Receivables tie: vendor_receivable equals the open vendor_outstanding (0), and cashback_receivable equals the summed cashback_outstanding (0). There are no duplicate idempotency_key or (type, user, reference_number) rows. Two NEW lower-severity defects, both on the claim-release path: (a) the pre-credit reversal runs before the 'check twice' guard, so a refused split leaves direct_added short by ₹118 and the pre-credit flag gone; (b) direct_referrals_count is bumped again on every release and re-trigger. Frontend: the /payment back arrow and Logout both show for testbuyer, and back goes to /shop. The upsell link is 175x44 and opens /payment. The amber payout-structure warning shows when cashback_enabled is false and hides when it is true. No deprecated Expo packages.

minor.issue: The direct_added reversal runs, and offline_pre_credit_amount is $unset, BEFORE _credit_no_ref_signup_to_admin's 'check twice' guard. When the guard refuses (paid flag missing, or no payment row and no GST-at-create flag), the claim is released but the ₹118 reversal stays. direct_added drops ₹118 while nothing is booked (probe F6: da −118, member 0, ds 0). Because the flag is already unset, the guard's `offline_pre_credit_amount > 0` branch (server.py:730) can never be true; it is dead code. In practice the UPI path always sets registration_gst_collected_at_create, so this only bites when that write fails or registration_paid is not set yet.

The inviter's direct_referrals_count is $inc'd before the split runs. Each release followed by a re-trigger bumps it again: skip once, then pay, gives a count of 2 for one invitee (probe F3). No money moves, but the count shown on the roster is inflated.

The SUBREV claim row is inserted BEFORE the bucket credits. If the process dies between the claim and credit_admin_bucket, every later retry sees the claim and returns, so the revenue/GST is never booked. Low probability. Consider booking buckets with $inc in the same step, or a reconciler that checks for a SUBREV claim without a SUBREVROW row.

gst_to_book reads the caller's (possibly stale) `joiner` dict instead of `fresh_joiner`, which was re-read a few lines above. It works today because upi_manual re-reads before calling. Use fresh_joiner for consistency.

Info / business check. On a UPI joining the ₹18 GST row is written, but the gst_collected bucket gets +0; Razorpay joinings get +18. finance.py Group 3 shows entry GST for Razorpay joinings only (a documented June-2026 rule). The owner's ask says '18 rupees in GST Ledger' for every subscription, so confirm UPI/offline joinings are meant to stay out of the GST ledger.

issues: payment-back and payment-logout iconBtn are 40x40, under the 44pt minimum touch target (payment.tsx:553). Add hitSlop or size them to 44.

The reveal-upsell tap target is fine at 175x44, but its text is 11px muted with numberOfLines=1, and it sits above the ₹1.18 price on its own line, which looks detached. Consider 12-13px and aligning it with the price row.

rca_of_issue: F6: _trigger_referral_commissions claims, reverses the offline pre-credit (direct_added −fee, $unset offline_pre_credit_amount), and only THEN calls _credit_no_ref_signup_to_admin. That function re-reads the user, and when the guard refuses it releases only commission_triggered. Repro: user with registration_paid=True, offline_pre_credit_amount=118, no registration_fee row, no gst flag → trigger → direct_added −118, nothing booked. Fix: move the guard ahead of the reversal, or roll the reversal back on refusal. F3 counter: the $inc of direct_referrals_count sits before the split. Repro: paid user with no payment row and a member inviter → trigger (released) → insert row → trigger → count=2.
